snippet.title: Seven Nexus - Trailer
snippet.description:
#SevenNexus #BLits #HeartskipGames

A brand-new collaboration title between BLits Games and Heartskip Games!

Follow the story of Grey, a young man who dies but can't go to Heaven or Hell. He must complete Seven Trials on Earth, accompanied by two Guardians: the angel, Haelo, and the devil, Horne. Each choice draws Grey towards virtue or sin... and into deeper intimacy with his Guardians. 

Trailer Video by Howl

Play the FREE DEMO & Wishlist the game on Steam!

Follow our website, newsletter and more for more info!
